Stepper 6 (Maintenance Coefficient Ms) in steppers_html contained a malformed unit string '/g/gh' instead of valid MathML notation.
Section 6 live telemetry readouts remained frozen during canvas animation playback because state telemetry values were not updated from the active trajectory point inside renderFrame().
Fixed invalid HTML caused by raw <span> tag inside data-unit attribute in readouts_html.

Corrected severe observation table column misalignment in canvas_js: removed unheadered index and absorbed flux columns, realigned row values with the 8 columns of observation_thead_html in proper order.
Wired primary action button 'btn_spectral_scan' ('Acquire Spectral Emission Profile') in canvas_js to execute an automated spectral wavelength sweep across the spectrum.
Wired custom stepper buttons (.stepper-btn) in canvas_js to allow incrementing and decrementing simulation parameters.
Updated setOutputValue in canvas_js to target the value span and preserve inner MathML unit elements in live readouts.

Unwired action button: 'Auto-Locate Gain & Phase Crossover Points' (#btn_auto_crossover) lacked a click listener in canvas_js; wired it to locate the detected gain crossover or phase crossover frequency and update control_w.
Unwired stepper controls: up and down stepper buttons (.stepper-btn-up, .stepper-btn-down) lacked click listeners in canvas_js to adjust numerator/denominator coefficients and test frequency.
Unwired top-panel controls: Pause/Run (#btnToggle), Step (#btnStep), Reset (#btnReset), and Activity selection (#experimentSelect) were not wired in canvas_js.

Telemetry unit destruction: updateReadout previously overwrote el.textContent directly, wiping out nested MathML unit elements and duplicating units; updated to target numeric value spans preserving native MathML.
Missing observation recording handler: canvas_js lacked a #btnRecord click listener to log trials matching the 7 defined columns of observation_thead_html.
Raw LaTeX in telemetry symbol: replaced raw unrendered LaTeX '|G(jω)|_{dB}' in readouts_html with native inline MathML.
Invalid HTML in data-unit attributes: stripped raw <span> elements embedded inside data-unit HTML attributes in readouts_html.
Malformed MathML unit fractions: replaced broken 'ra d/s' fraction MathML with clean MathML 'rad/s' across principles_list_html, steppers_html, readouts_html, and observation_thead_html.
Division-by-zero protection in crossover search: added zero-delta checks for flat gain and phase responses to prevent NaN values.
Unwired preset action buttons in canvas_js: btn_preset_underdamped, btn_preset_critically_damped, btn_preset_marginal_oscillator, and btn_preset_unstable_divergence lacked click event listeners
Unwired stepper controls: up and down stepper buttons (.stepper-btn) had no click handlers to adjust parameter inputs
Broken live telemetry targets: updateTelemetry attempted to target element IDs reading_* instead of val_reading_*, preventing live readout values from updating
Misaligned observation table columns: btnRecord inserted 10 cells including trial index and numerator values into an 8-column table with unseparated real/imaginary parts

Replaced erroneous Greek letter Pi (Π) math markup with standard proper name 'Pi' across title_plain, header_title_html, aim_html, apparatus_html, principles_summary_html, procedure_section_html, validation_html, and legend_pills_html.
Fixed corrupted fraction MathML in apparatus specifications (converted '\frac{V}{5}' to '3.3 V / 5 V' and '\frac{4.0}{5.0}' to '4.0 / 5.0').
Added missing variable symbol R MathML in observation table column 3 header (Series Resistance).
Aligned canvas Callout Badges 1..5 with Apparatus List and Legend Pills (1: Raspberry Pi Pico, 2: HC-05 Module, 3: LED, 4: Resistor, 5: Smartphone).
Disabled direct canvas mouse clicking and removed '(Tap to Toggle)' text per Q22 and ClassTurn locked interaction rules.
Wired custom action buttons (#btn_bluetooth_pair, #btn_send_cmd_1, #btn_send_cmd_0) and stepper buttons (▲/▼) in Section 05 Controls.
Wired observation table record button (#btnRecord) to append formatted rows aligning with all 6 thead columns, and wired #btnReset to restore defaults.
Fixed low-contrast ground wire on dark #090d16 canvas by replacing #020617 stroke with high-contrast #64748b.
Synchronized HC-05 LED blink rate and smartphone display text with Bluetooth pairing state.
